decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom builds directly on the firm's scanning-phantom and dosimetry expertise, and the firm is still learning from clinical feedback at proton centres, so keeping it lets that capability mature.

Small volume chambers are core dosimetry know-how the firm can calibrate and refine in-house, but having already withdrawn the overlapping Product C, management keeps B as the remaining small-field offering.
The standard clinical chamber line is central to the established business and fully absorbed into accredited calibration and service, so dropping it would make no sense.
The relative dosimetry chamber complements the firm's water phantoms and QA workflows using closely related knowledge, supporting the integrated platform strategy.
Thimble chambers are a long-standing core competence with long regulatory and clinical life cycles that the firm's physicists can support and improve.
